claim: SpanUQ, a ~25M-parameter probe over frozen hidden states, estimates span-level uncertainty (AUROC 0.908-0.944) on a 20K-prompt, ~293K-span benchmark, outperforming sampling methods at 10-20x lower cost.
stance_target: L4 granularity: span-level probes exist for factual text, not code
scope_conditions: Qwen3-14B/8B/4B/30B-A3B, Mistral-7B; five domains; labels from multi-sample claim verification
quoted_support: a lightweight ( ∼25M parameter) probe that distills the uncertainty knowledge from expensive multi-sample inference into a single forward pass over LLM hidden states

breadth.confidence_families: hidden-state span probe (DETR decoder, Mixture of Beta), sampling baselines (Sec 3-4)
breadth.benchmarks: SpanUQ-Bench, 20K queries, five domains, factual generation (Sec 1); code not evaluated
breadth.label_independence: labels derived from the model's own samples
